nodes.text: @jakki_jax Oh Hon I'm so sorry. I'm glad you are seeing a pulmonologist. Maybe time for some FenBen when you get better, just focus of breathing and getting rest. Sleep is hard to get when you can't breathe. Tell Craig to hang in there I'm sure he scared for you.
